STAT ION BICHHUA DISTRICT CHHINDWARA  (MADHYA PRADESH)
 
 (BY MS. GEETA YADAV - PANEL LAWYER)
 This application coming on for admission this day, the c  following:
 ORDER
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant has been arrested, therefore, this bail application under section 438 of Cr.P.C has rendered infructuous.

I n view of aforesaid, this first bail application under Section 438 of Cr.P.C filed on behalf of the applicant for grant of anticipatory bail relating to F.I.R.No.119/2023, dated 26.04.2023 registered at P.S. Bicchua, District Chhindwara (M.P.) for offence punishable under sections 294, 376(2)(n) and 506 of IPC is dismissed having rendered infructuous.

(DINESH KUMAR PALIWAL) JUDGE AT Babichand Vishwakarma vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 19 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/26414320/
